scenarios.title: Compact current-note controls, bound sidebar preview and map drop feedback
steps: Open Native outline.md in source mode. Open Current note at about 280 px width. Inspect compact file/status header, inherited and overridden virtual/stored/scheme controls, hidden successful-save status, collapsed advanced and write tools, and absence of horizontal overflow. Toggle stored visibility and restore inheritance; verify concealment inversion and preserve source except the explicit Properties changes.

From Current note invoke Write, Renumber, Remove and Strip markers in turn. Verify each switches the sidebar to an internal preview with fixed filename, counts, complete differences/warnings and Back/Cancel/Apply, rather than appending below controls or opening a Modal. Cancel each without writes. Invoke a current-note command and verify the same sidebar page. Batch still opens its wide Modal.

Create a write preview for Native outline.md; switch to Reference navigation.md while keeping the original editor open. Verify target filename stays Native outline.md and an applied plan changes only that original file with one native Undo restoring source. Create another preview, edit the target source, then Apply: verify a local stale error, no overwrite, preview retained and Back allows rebuilding. Restore deliberate fixture edits.

Open the map for Native outline.md, enable the visible Adjust structure mode and inspect its active status and exposed move buttons. Begin a same-parent/same-level drag; capture an actual screenshot while holding above and below a valid peer, including target highlight and before/after insertion marker. Complete one drag and native Undo; compare the complete original source.

Attempt a cross-parent or cross-level target and inspect the concise local rejection reason without Notice flooding or writes. Cancel a drag and perform an adjacent no-op; neither reports an error. Where feasible test no matching source editor and changed-source rejection; missing observations remain unverified. Leave source restored and record the actual limited observations separately from historical scenarios.
expected: Compact controls stay readable within a narrow sidebar; inheritance/effective values and inverse stored-visibility mapping are correct; pending/error/conflict saves remain visible.

All single-note actions use one shared sidebar preview and immutable bounded original-file plans; note switches cannot retarget and stale sources are rejected. Back/Cancel and successful Apply return to Current note. Batch remains separate.

Adjust structure exposes accessible movement controls and clear before/after insertion feedback. Only same-parent/same-level whole sections move in one native Undo transaction; rejected targets explain locally and cancel/no-op do not misreport errors.

scenarios.title: Native Outline projection, entry migration and reload preserve source and pane ownership
steps: In a fresh isolated Vault open Native outline.md and record exact source/hash. Before enabling the core Outline plugin, run the legacy Open Number Suite outline command and the ribbon entry. Verify Current note opens directly without obsolete Document outline/tabs; inspect the helpful core-Outline enablement guidance and confirm the core plugin remains disabled until explicitly enabled by the operator.

Enable core Outline through Obsidian settings. Verify the three independent Number Suite switches for heading numbers, H7-H9 and captions initially default on. Turn each off independently, reload Number Suite through Community plugins and verify each saved explicit false survives; restore all three on. Compare heading numbers with body labels using Hierarchical and one custom scheme, then restore the initial scheme. Confirm source/hash remains unchanged.

Inspect H1-H9 and all four caption types in native Outline. Headings have small number pills plus text; caption rows have localized type icons/ordinals and secondary titles, no whole-row pill and no expand arrow. Alpha figure/Table/Equation/Code appear within their containing sections in source order and match body effective counters. Collapse/expand and filter the tree; counts must not restart or change.

Navigate from every extension level and caption to the correct source line, move the source caret and verify native current-location following. Open Reference navigation.md as a second note and, where the host exposes it, a second Outline pane; pin Native outline.md in its pane, change active editors and verify each pane retains its own source and filtering/collapse behavior. A host lacking a required pin/multiple-pane operation must be recorded as unverified rather than inferred from one pane.

Open the mind map from each native Outline toolbar action and the Current note header after switching to an unrelated editor. Verify the map is bound to the triggering pane file. Run the map command separately and verify its follow-active-note behavior. Confirm no command opens the removed Document outline.

In this disposable Vault only, exercise upgrade migration from an old workspace sidebar state with its outline/current-note tab values and an existing legacy command shortcut. Restore/reopen the workspace, invoke that shortcut and inspect the direct Current note result. Disable/re-enable and unload/reload Number Suite; native Outline must remain usable without duplicate entries, decorations or toolbar actions. If an old-state input was not exercised, report migration unverified. Compare both fixture sources/hashes with baseline and keep desktop/Android observations separate.
expected: Core Outline is never automatically enabled. Ribbon, legacy entries and migrated sidebar state expose Current note without the removed UI; three independent controls preserve explicit false values across reload.

Native Outline shows effective H1-H9 and leaf captions in source order, preserves native filtering/collapse/following/pinning/multiple-pane behavior and binds each map action correctly without changing Markdown or the shared metadata cache.
Display, migration and lifecycle checks leave both Markdown fixtures byte-identical. Missing native behavior or migration evidence is unverified, not a pass.

scenarios.title: Complete extended sections reorder safely in native Outline and explicit map mode
steps: Open Native outline.md in a matching Markdown editor with native Outline enhancements on. Record the entire baseline source/hash and identify Seven Alpha/Beta, Eight Alpha/Beta and Nine Alpha/Beta peers, their body sentinels, captions and descendant headings. Leave source numbers virtual so movement cannot be confused with stored-number rewriting.

In native Outline drag Seven Alpha after Seven Beta and before it again, Eight Alpha after Eight Beta, and Nine Alpha after Nine Beta. For every operation observe the before/after insertion marker, confirm the complete moved section retains its prose, caption objects and descendants, then use native Undo followed by Redo and a final Undo to restore the exact pre-operation bytes. On Android perform actual touch/long-press drags and record the gesture and resulting source; button actions cannot substitute for touch drag evidence.

Attempt to move Seven Alpha under Other parent, to a different-level Eight row, onto a caption, and to an invalid empty-space target. Try dragging a caption independently. Each unsupported move must leave the complete source unchanged and must not change heading parent or level. Verify ordinary H1-H6 native dragging/operations remain available while extension/caption rows are visible; restore the source using native Undo.

Exercise stale-source rejection: begin dragging an extended section, change its source snapshot from another matching editor before release, then drop on a formerly valid peer. The drag must not overwrite the intervening edit. Preserve the modified source as evidence before removing only the deliberate test edit. If the host cannot stage a real intervening edit during a drag, record this check unverified; ordinary cancel/release is not stale-source evidence.

Open the map using the source-bound Outline action. Verify ordinary browse dragging does not edit sections. Enable Adjust structure; drag complete same-parent/same-level sections with visible insertion targets, then use Move section up and Move section down on the same peers. Verify both paths include descendants/captions, reject unsupported targets, preserve source-file pinning across focus changes and use native Undo/Redo. Android requires a real touch drag in map edit mode in addition to successful buttons.

Switch to a different note and confirm edit mode does not carry an armed drag across files. Disable/re-enable and unload/reload the plugin, reopen native Outline and map, and check no stuck drag or duplicate controls. Undo all accepted fixture moves and deliberate source edits, compare the entire Native outline.md source/hash to baseline, and record Windows and Android separately.
expected: H7-H9 native Outline dragging and explicit map structure editing move only complete same-parent/same-level sections, show clear insertion targets and preserve prose, objects, captions and descendants.

Every accepted move is one bounded editor undo transaction with functioning Undo/Redo. Wrong-parent, wrong-level, caption, stale-source and invalid-target attempts do not overwrite source; native H1-H6 operations remain available.
Actual Android touch dragging is observed separately from up/down access. Missing gesture, concurrency or pinning evidence remains unverified; final fixture bytes exactly match baseline.

scenarios.title: Explicit reference navigation and source editing coexist with opt-in native same-file Wiki labels
steps: Open Reference navigation.md in Live Preview with virtual numbers and explicit references enabled; record full source/hash. Verify ordinary Wiki heading enhancement is initially off: ordinary bare, aliased and file-qualified links retain native labels/actions. Inactive explicit title, alias, caption and heading-owned block references show their expected labels. The explicit paragraph control retains its native link and has no Number Suite label.

Single-click each explicit title/alias/caption/block reference and verify navigation to the correct authored target on the first click, without requiring a first click to reveal source. Focus an explicit reference and use F2 on desktop; on Android use the visible mobile-accessible source-edit action. Verify the exact authored marker/alias becomes editable, dismiss without edits, and confirm an unrelated inactive reference remains rendered. Record source-edit access independently from navigation.

Enable Enhance ordinary same-note Wiki heading links. In Live Preview and Reading View verify the unique local, aliased, file-qualified basename and .md forms receive exactly one inert effective number; aliases remain authored text and native navigation, modifier/context actions remain owned by Obsidian. Move the caret across links and switch views to check source access and absence of duplicated labels.

Inspect cross-file, block, embed, ordinary Markdown, missing and ambiguous control links. None receives the ordinary-heading enhancement or a plugin-owned replacement interaction. Compare the supported explicit heading block with the unnumbered explicit paragraph control. Confirm Link metadata boundaries.md still excludes protected metadata; do not infer a native table source-to-DOM mapping from this simpler fixture.

Turn the ordinary Wiki option off, reload Number Suite and confirm the saved false remains false and ordinary links return to native labels/actions. Turn it on and repeat reload, Reading View, Source mode and Live Preview. Disable/unload the plugin and verify decorations/source-edit controls are removed without breaking native links, then re-enable and verify only one copy returns.

In the disposable Vault exercise old settings without the ordinary Wiki field and confirm the option migrates to off. Observe English and Simplified Chinese source-edit labels and Outline caption type labels without changing authored text. Return to the initial settings and view, compare full source/hash with baseline and record desktop and Android separately. Do not mark F2-only desktop evidence as mobile source-edit acceptance.
expected: Explicit references to headings and captions, including their block IDs, navigate on the first click and provide working F2 plus Android-accessible source editing without modifying authored markers or unrelated references. The ordinary paragraph target keeps its native link label.

The ordinary Wiki option defaults/migrates to off, preserves explicit false and, when enabled, adds only inert effective numbers to unique same-file heading links in Live Preview and Reading View, including file-qualified forms and aliases.

Native interactions and excluded link classes remain intact through source/view/lifecycle changes. Full fixture bytes remain identical; each platform and missing interaction is reported independently.

scenarios.title: Note-definition labels survive plugin reload and remain editable
steps: In a fresh isolated Vault open Link metadata boundaries.md in Live Preview with formatted note numbers enabled. Record the complete source/hash and place the caret on the final blank line. Verify the real and next definition labels are [1] and [2]; record their native DOM separately from the ordinary Body reference.

Switch to Reading View, disable Number Suite through Community plugins and close Settings. Verify native content returns. Re-enable Number Suite, close Settings and return to Live Preview. Both definition labels must return once without a Source-mode reset. Repeat this lifecycle once, then move the caret into ordinary Body text and check both definitions again.

Select inside the real definition marker. Its exact authored marker must become editable while the inactive next definition retains [2]. Leave the marker and verify [1] returns. On Android open and dismiss the keyboard without entering text; record whether the active marker stays accessible and the inactive label remains intact.

Switch to Source mode and back to Live Preview. Check exact markers in Source mode and restored single labels in Live Preview, then compare the full source/hash to the baseline. Record Windows and Android outcomes separately. Diagnostic observation commands may collect supplementary evidence but cannot substitute for these visible behavior checks.
expected: Each reload restores both definition labels without duplicates or a mode-reset workaround; selecting a marker exposes exact source and leaving restores its label.
Reading View cleanup, Source mode and inactive labels remain correct. The complete Markdown source is byte-identical after all display-only interactions.

scenarios.title: Read-only native note rendering evidence across plugin reload
steps: In a fresh isolated Vault open the unchanged Link metadata boundaries.md fixture in Live Preview, enable formatted note numbers and cross-references, and place the caret on the final blank line. Record the full source/hash and visible note labels. Run Number Suite acceptance provider: Record note rendering: initial through the command palette to collect the initial observation.

Switch to Reading View, disable Number Suite through Community plugins and close Settings; observe native reference restoration. Re-enable Number Suite, close Settings, then return to Live Preview. Without editing the fixture, inspect both definition labels and run Record note rendering: reloaded. Record visible absence, presence or duplication without assuming an outcome.

Click ordinary Body text outside its reference marker and record whether definition labels change. Run Record note rendering: caret. Switch to Source mode and back to Live Preview, inspect labels and run Record note rendering: mode-reset. Compare the full source/hash with the baseline.

Retain number-suite-note-rendering-initial.json, number-suite-note-rendering-reloaded.json, number-suite-note-rendering-caret.json and number-suite-note-rendering-mode-reset.json with their corresponding screenshots through the native owner. Each JSON reports actual DOM, already-computed decoration ranges and editor state; the observer never refreshes the product, dispatches a transaction or issues a product pass. Missing internal fields are diagnostic limitations, not proof that decorations are absent. Record desktop and Android separately.
expected: Four bounded, immutable observations distinguish the initial state, reload state, ordinary-caret control and mode-reset state while preserving the exact fixture bytes.
The record identifies actual host behavior and any missing evidence. Diagnostic collection alone does not establish that plugin lifecycle behavior passed.

scenarios.title: Multiline link titles and native table-cell boundaries
steps: Open Link metadata boundaries.md in an isolated Vault. Record its complete source and hash. Enable virtual heading numbers, cross-references and formatted note numbers in Live Preview and Reading View; keep the cursor in ordinary text when observing inactive decorations.

Inspect the multiline link and the valid link inside one table cell. Their title metadata must not contribute a ghost note number or a hidden cross-reference pill. The ordinary Body reference must be footnote 1 and its body cross-reference must still target Target.

Inspect the final table, where the apparent title crosses an unescaped cell boundary and a row boundary. Its visible cell marker remains a real footnote after real, and its visible semantic reference remains eligible for enhancement. Record actual native table rendering and any source-to-DOM refusal separately; do not count an unavailable native correspondence as a displayed pass.

Switch between Live Preview and Reading View, then disable and re-enable the plugin. Check restoration without duplicate decorations, inspect Source mode and compare the complete original source/hash. Record desktop and Android outcomes separately.
expected: Valid link metadata contributes no notes or semantic references; visible prose and invalid cross-cell title lookalikes retain their semantics. Native rendering and plugin decoration are recorded independently.
View changes and lifecycle transitions do not write Markdown. Disabling restores native content, and re-enabling does not duplicate decorations.

scenarios.title: Localized Properties details preserve authored keys and values
steps: Open Diagnostic locales.md and record its complete source/hash. Open Current note. In Number Suite General settings select English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese in turn, returning to Current note after each change.

For each language inspect both diagnostic details, not only the section heading. The invalid item explanation and unknown directive explanation must use the selected language while retaining heading.virtual=maybe and heading.unrecognized exactly as authored.

Return to the original language, reopen Current note and verify no stale language or duplicate diagnostics remain. Compare the source/hash and acceptance-keep property with the baseline. Record desktop and Android outcomes independently; the other supported languages remain covered by source tests.
expected: Both diagnostic details follow the selected language while exact directive keys and raw input values remain unchanged and readable as plain text.
Inspecting diagnostics or changing the UI language does not write the note or remove invalid Properties.

scenarios.title: Batch preview file ownership and safe-integer counter limits
steps: Use an isolated Vault containing Batch safety/Original.md, Batch safety/Second.md and Counter overflow.md. Record their complete original source and hashes. Select Hierarchical globally, with source markers disabled.

Open batch editing and check that neither scope nor operation is preselected. Choose Batch safety and Write in the same dialog. Preview must name that folder and operation and report two notes checked, two to edit, two changes and zero warnings. Back keeps the choices. Switch to Remove Number Suite markers, verify zero notes to edit, disabled Apply and working Back. Switch back to Write for the identity test.

Preview a write limited to the Batch safety folder. Keep the preview open, rename Original.md to Moved.md, and create a new Original.md with byte-identical content. Wait until the host registers both files, then confirm the original preview. Confirm a changed-batch notice, no numbering in any of the three notes, and no new recovery snapshot.

Dismiss the stale preview and restore the fixture paths. Start a fresh preview, confirm, then restore the last batch. Verify both original notes return exactly to their recorded source. This is the positive control for the same candidate.

In a separate temporary copy of Original.md use the heading '# 1. Original'. Preview Remove numbers with plugin-owned recognition, change recognition to common prefixes and verify the preview now removes '1. '. Before confirmation rename the source and create an identical replacement at its old path; confirm and verify no file is changed. Repeat replacement before changing recognition: the old preview must not produce a writable replan.

Open Counter overflow.md in Live Preview and Reading View. The first H1 may show 9007199254740991; later H1 headings and the dependent child must not display a repeated or rounded number, and the reference to Second must not acquire an invalid number. Preview Write numbers and Renumber: each must explain counter overflow and offer no Markdown changes. Cancel and compare the complete original source.

On Android use the same registered-file replacement cases and visible preview controls; record emulator outcomes separately from desktop. Preserve all user edits and report unavailable interactions as unverified.
expected: Original file objects and paths remain bound from the preview reads through cleanup replanning and confirmation. Identical replacement text cannot authorize a write, and stale batches do not create recovery records or modify unaffected notes.

Safe counters retain their exact labels, overflowed or dependent counters remain unavailable, and write/renumber refuse the whole note with an explicit warning. Cleanup remains a separate supported operation.

scenarios.title: Table termination and stable caption IDs at inline syntax boundaries
steps: Use a clean temporary Vault with only the candidate plugin. Enable Live Preview, Reading View and caption numbering; record the full source baselines for Boundary table.md and Boundary caption syntax.md. Inspect first without editing.

In Boundary table.md, open the context menu on Heading | Content in editing mode. It must not be a table-caption target. Inspect the first table menu: no caption write may cross that heading to claim Below the intervening heading. The heading remains a heading in both display modes.

On the second table, preview moving Valid adjacent caption above the table, cancel once, then confirm. Verify only the second table-caption pair changes. Undo once through the host and compare the complete note with its baseline.

In Boundary caption syntax.md, try Copy cross-reference on HTML comment and Obsidian comment, then Multiline link. Each action must refuse without writing or copying a new unresolved reference. These are the representative host paths; the code/tag/image/emphasis/strike variants remain available for a distinct failure investigation and are otherwise covered by source tests.

On Closed HTML comment, inspect the stable-reference preview, cancel once, then confirm. Verify the new ID is outside the closed syntax, belongs to that caption and the copied link resolves to it. Keep pasted links in a separate scratch note so one editor undo in the fixture restores its exact baseline. Other Closed examples are optional diagnostic controls, not required host repetitions.

On Android perform the table and caption menus through actual long press, use the soft keyboard for scratch-note paste, and use on-screen undo. Record unsupported menu paths as unverified, separate from desktop results.
expected: The intervening heading never becomes a table row, and table operations never capture a caption beyond it. The valid adjacent pair remains writable with an exact preview and one undo.
Multiline syntax is never split by a hidden or unowned block ID. Closed syntax permits a resolvable stable reference. Canceled/refused actions and display-only operations preserve full source bytes.

scenarios.title: Invalid heading directives and cleanup with a missing parent
steps: Record complete source baselines for Boundary invalid Properties.md, Boundary valid Properties.md and Boundary orphan cleanup.md. In global settings choose Hierarchical, the missing-parent Skip strategy and the plugin-owned cleanup scope. Keep source-marker writing disabled; the cleanup fixture already contains literal U+2060 markers.

Open Boundary invalid Properties.md and Current note. Verify heading.first-number.h10=2 is invalid; attempt to change virtual numbering. The operation must be rejected and both number-suite and acceptance-keep must remain unchanged. The heading.skip-first.foo=2 variant is covered by automated tests; use an editor copy only if investigating a distinct host issue.

Open Boundary valid Properties.md as the valid control. Verify Current note accepts it and H1 starts at 2. H9 and preservation of all supported directives are covered by source tests; do not duplicate every setting change in each host.

In Boundary orphan cleanup.md, preview Remove numbers, cancel once, then confirm. Only the balanced U+2060-2-U+2060 prefix on the first H2 may disappear; the year, decimal, measurement, unmarked manual prefix and one-sided marker must remain. Undo once and compare the whole file.

From the restored baseline, preview Remove source markers and confirm. Only the two balanced markers on the first H2 disappear; its visible 2 remains. Undo once and verify exact restoration. Automated tests cover the unchanged write/renumber missing-parent behavior.
On Android use the visible host undo control after each cleanup write; record preview, write and undo results separately. Restore the saved global settings at the end.
expected: Unsupported heading directives fail closed and rejected control changes preserve the source Properties. Valid H1/H9 directives still work and survive unrelated valid changes.
Missing parents do not block removal of a confirmed owned prefix or stripping of its markers. Unowned and ambiguous prefixes remain unchanged; each confirmed cleanup is restored by one editor undo.

scenarios.title: Reference ownership, escaped backticks and nested note lists
steps: Enable virtual heading numbers with Hierarchical, cross-references, note numbering and formatted note labels in both Live Preview and Reading View. Record full source baselines for Boundary reference labels.md, Boundary ambiguous references.md and Boundary nested notes.md. Place the editor cursor in ordinary text when inspecting inactive display.

In Boundary reference labels.md inspect and follow all four first-paragraph references: aliased/unaliased title targets and aliased/unaliased block-ID targets must bind to Heading. Check literal versus real in the next paragraph: the escaped ordinary link retains its native label and @, and only the semantic reference receives a pill. Check the reference between escaped backticks is enhanced and the actual code span stays literal. Remaining formatted/entity paragraphs are diagnostic inputs for a distinct mapping issue, with source tests covering those variants.

In Boundary ambiguous references.md inspect the second paragraph, which combines native HTML code and an entity-prefixed link with identical aliases. Capture actual native rendering and correspondence. When source-to-DOM correspondence is unverifiable, preserve native links and @ characters with no partial decoration. The other alias variants need no duplicate host run unless this representative case exposes a distinct issue.

In Boundary nested notes.md verify plain and ticks are footnotes 1 and 2, final is endnote E1, and repeated references reuse their numbers. The literal marker inside actual code remains literal. Inspect native definition backlinks and the nested bullet/ordered lists: list text, numbering and nesting must remain unchanged.

Switch views, switch away and back, then disable the plugin. Compare labels, @ characters, formatted link children, note definitions and nested lists with the native baseline. Re-enable and verify restoration without duplicate decorations or source writes.

On Android repeat in portrait with touch navigation, open and dismiss the soft keyboard in ordinary body text, and switch views. Record desktop and Android observations independently; no write or undo operation is needed for this display-only scenario.
expected: Only semantically verified references are enhanced and navigate to their actual target. Ambiguous mappings preserve native rendering. Escaped literal backticks do not suppress otherwise valid references or footnotes, while actual code spans remain protected.
Footnote/endnote numbering follows source semantics without consuming nested list items. Disabling the plugin restores native rendered content and all note bytes remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: Figure, Table and Equation placement across native Reading View sections
steps: Open Boundary section placement.md in the exact native host with caption numbering enabled. Record its full bytes/hash and mtime. Keep the three caption-carrier pairs separated as authored; record host version and whether each pair actually occupies separate native Reading View sections.

In Reading View set Figure, Table and Equation placement above, inspect all three, then set all three below and inspect again. Observe each caption against the visible img, inner table or display-math rectangle with one compact gap. A numbered pill alone is insufficient evidence of binding or movement. Use Figure in Live Preview as the representative editor control; expand to the other carriers only for distinct failures.

Record each observed type/view/placement result and native source-section relationship. If separate native sections cannot be established, mark that cross-section claim unverified even when same-section placement works. Do not substitute a synthetic DOM pass for native placement evidence or claim unexecuted combinations passed.

Enter the Figure caption in Live Preview, inspect exact source at its authored location, move out and check visual placement returns. In Source mode inspect unchanged Markdown, then follow its block-ID reference and confirm caption/carrier ownership remains distinct. Source tests cover the other reference variants.

Switch notes/views and disable/re-enable the plugin. Native source location must return on disable and placement must restore on enable. On Android use touch, the soft keyboard and portrait width. Compare bytes/hash/mtime at the end and restore saved placement settings.
expected: Report the actual native placement result for each caption type and view independently. Caption position follows its selected side of the intended carrier when binding succeeds; a cross-section defect is a finding only when reproduced.
Visual placement, source reveal, lifecycle changes and reference navigation never rewrite Markdown or reassign caption/carrier IDs. Missing cross-section evidence is recorded explicitly.

scenarios.title: Native multiline inline-math rendering and stable caption ID ownership
steps: Record the source baseline of Boundary caption math.md and inspect Multiline math, Closed math and Plain math control in Live Preview and Reading View. First record whether this host actually renders the multiline dollar-delimited text as one inline-math expression; do not assume it does.

Try Copy cross-reference on Multiline math. Record refusal or the exact preview without applying an unreviewed insertion. If a proposed insertion visibly bisects syntax rendered as one math expression, cancel and record the finding. If it can safely be confirmed, verify the new ID resolves to the visible caption, then use one host undo to restore the baseline. Keep pasted links in a separate scratch note.

Use Closed math and Plain math control as positive controls: inspect, confirm, verify each copied target and undo once. On Android use actual long press, scratch-note paste with the soft keyboard and on-screen undo.

Report native rendering, preview, write/no-write and ID ownership as separate observations. If the host does not support multiline inline math, record that case as unverified for multiline-math safety rather than declaring a reproduced defect or a general pass.
expected: This investigation establishes actual native syntax and stable-ID behavior without presuming a product failure. A confirmed supported caption reference must resolve to its intended owner and undo must restore the exact baseline.
No accepted operation may hide an ID inside a rendered expression or split the expression. Cancellation and refusal leave source unchanged; unsupported native math remains an explicit limitation.

scenarios.title: Code caption fence boundaries and protected note continuations
steps: Open Code fence boundaries.md in Live Preview and Reading View. The frontmatter-adjacent code block must bind its existing Code caption. Inspect both views without editing and verify the full Markdown bytes remain unchanged.

In editing mode, open the context menu inside frontmatterValue. Inspect the preview that moves the existing caption above the entire code block, cancel once, then confirm. Undo once and verify the exact original source is restored.

Open the context menu inside secondValue in the immediately adjacent tilde-fenced block. Add a Code caption using its preview, verify only the second complete object is targeted, then undo once. The first block must remain unchanged.

In Source mode, open context menus inside plainProtected, footnoteProtected and endnoteProtected, including a fence boundary. None may offer a Code caption action. Repeat for the commentProtected and htmlProtected lookalikes; verify all protected source bytes remain unchanged.
On Android, perform the affected context actions through real long press, the soft keyboard and on-screen undo. Record observed view/menu behavior and any unverified path separately.
expected: Real top-level code objects immediately after frontmatter or another fence remain caption targets, and existing captions bind in both display modes.
Footnote/endnote continuations, comments and HTML never become Code caption targets. Canceled operations and display-only use do not write; one host undo restores each confirmed write exactly.

scenarios.title: Container protection and caption reference preservation
steps: In a narrow desktop sidebar and Android portrait sidebar, open current-note overrides and select a long scheme name. Labels and descriptions must remain readable and the dropdown must stay within the panel; verify the selection can be changed.

Open Caption and container safety in Live Preview and Reading View. Record the full source. Virtual numbering must include only Visible before, Visible after and Final visible heading. Preview write/renumber, cancel, then apply and undo once: list/quote headings, fenced caption and all protected bytes must remain unchanged.

Use the image menu to normalize and move the lowercase figure caption above its carrier. Inspect the exact preview, confirm, follow the caption-id cross-reference, undo and redo. Preserve caption-id and image-id and reference ownership; a confirmed operation must be one host undo step.

Attempt relocation across object-one and object-two: no write action may discard or reassign the second ID. Open a valid preview, change the original source in another pane, then confirm; stale confirmation must write nothing.

When the exact Structural Tables companion is installed in the declared interoperability environment, leave the cursor in the first byte-identical table and open the second table menu. The caption preview and write must target the second table only. Repeat both plugin load orders and disable/re-enable. With the old companion, require safe Source-mode fallback instead of ordinal or cursor substitution.
On Android use the real long-press menu, soft keyboard and on-screen undo/redo. Record each observed path and any environment-specific omission separately.
expected: Display-only mode preserves full source bytes. Writes touch only previewed top-level targets and one undo restores the exact baseline.

Authored block IDs and their reference owners survive normalization/relocation. Ambiguous or stale targets are refused with zero writes. Companion behavior is reported separately from the clean single-plugin baseline.

scenarios.title: Language switching, scoped RTL and regional numeric safety
steps: Open Regional numbers.md with Document outline and Heading map. Record the selected numbering scheme and source bytes. Switch UI language English to Arabic and back with the map open; inspect all seven settings tabs, commands, outline, map and a write-preview modal.

In Arabic, search for mixed Arabic and Latin text in the map, select and collapse a branch, change scope and zoom, then switch language. Confirm map selection, search, collapse, scope and viewport remain. Check controls respond once and host panes retain their own direction.
Inspect mixed Arabic text with Docs/Report.md, Figure: and Markdown in editable inputs. Move the caret, select and copy text. On Android use the soft keyboard and narrow portrait/landscape layouts.

With default cleanup templates, preview Remove numbers and Renumber for Regional numbers.md. Confirm Arabic-Indic year, decimal, measurement, version and date headings are unchanged and warned about. Cancel; toggle stored-number concealment and confirm these authored values remain visible.

Explicitly select Arabic-Indic hierarchical numbering. Compare Live Preview, Reading View, outline and map, preview writing to the unnumbered headings, cancel once, then apply and undo/redo. Verify risky authored prefixes remain unchanged. Restore source and saved scheme, restart the plugin, and confirm the saved language and scheme persist independently.
expected: Language changes never alter the selected scheme or Markdown. Arabic direction stays scoped to plugin surfaces; inputs, narrow layouts and live map state remain usable.

Numeric false positives remain visible and unchanged. Only previewed supported headings are written; cancellation preserves bytes and undo restores source. Record each platform and any unverified interaction separately.

scenarios.title: Source Properties, comment offsets, stable copies and Chinese groups
steps: Open Review regressions.md in Reading View and Live Preview. Inspect H1-H6, the inline comment inside the stored prefix, long-title wrapping, and native collapse/expand. On desktop repeat the layout in default light and dark themes.
Toggle virtual display and stored-number concealment separately and together, then restore both. Switch notes and view modes. Disable and re-enable the plugin and inspect cleanup and restoration.

Open Quoted Properties.md and Duplicate Properties.md in editing, reading and Document outline. Confirm invalid Properties are rejected. Return to Review regressions.md and confirm valid Properties enable numbering.

Copy the existing review-anchor reference through the context menu; its duplicate inside a code example must not block the action. On desktop, change the bound source from another pane while the menu is open and confirm a stale copy is rejected.
Open the stable-reference preview on the last unanchored heading, inspect the ID and cancel. On Android also use long press, open the soft keyboard in body text, and switch modes after dismissing it.

Open Chinese numerals.md, compare both virtual labels with the stated values, open the current-note write preview and cancel. Confirm the preview matches the display and all fixture Markdown bytes remain unchanged.
expected: All visible numbers remain aligned and usable, including comment-spanning replacement points, folded headings and narrow wrapped titles. View changes and plugin cleanup leave no duplicate or residual decorations.

Invalid source Properties fail closed consistently, valid source Properties work, an existing unambiguous ID is copied despite protected examples, stale copies are cancelled, and Chinese group numerals retain one. Previews and display-only interactions preserve Markdown.

scenarios.title: Virtual heading numerals preserve native fold controls
steps: Open Heading fold layout.md in Reading View. Collapse and expand the first heading with the native arrow. Inspect the long H3 heading and multi-level numeral at narrow width.
Switch to Live Preview, inspect inactive numbered headings and use the native fold control. Return to Reading View and verify the layout remains stable.
expected: Native fold arrows remain outside numeral badges, and collapse and expansion work without changing the note. Numerals do not overlap title text or the native fold control at phone width.
Numbering remains consistent between views, long headings wrap without clipping, and Markdown bytes remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: Long and deeply nested outline rows in a narrow sidebar
steps: Open Heading map.md and Document outline in a narrow sidebar. Inspect the long H2 title and the H3-H9 rows below it, including their numbers. Scroll to Conclusion.
Collapse and expand Results, then select Level nine and confirm source navigation. On desktop also widen and narrow the sidebar.
expected: Wrapped text increases the row height without overlapping later rows. Deep titles use the available row width instead of being squeezed into a one-character column by number and indentation columns.
Collapse, expansion and navigation remain usable, all levels remain distinguishable, and these actions do not change Markdown bytes.

scenarios.title: Heading map opens and reopens through the host lifecycle
steps: Open Heading map.md and launch its heading map from Document outline. Verify the file label, search, scope and zoom controls, heading cards and connecting edges are visible.
Close the map tab and reopen it through the command palette. Confirm the toolbar and cards render again.
expected: Opening and reopening never leaves a blank content area; the host header and the map file label both remain usable. Long card titles show their beginning and an ellipsis, with the complete title available to assistive technology and desktop hover.
Both entry points open the current document without changing Markdown bytes.

scenarios.title: Document root, readable overview and subtree return
steps: Open Heading map.md. Verify the file root and its three top-level children, two structural heading depths at 100%, and plus/minus handles. Compare effective heading numbers (or Hn), skipped levels and direct-child counts with the source; captions must not be counted.
Collapse and expand the file root and Research. Select Research, switch to its subtree, then return through the file-name breadcrumb.
expected: The root represents the file with an icon rather than an invented heading number. Counts include only direct structural children; captions are excluded and leaves show a disabled zero handle. The initial view keeps text readable on narrow screens.
Collapse/expand keeps the clicked parent at the same screen position. Subtree and document navigation preserve their stated scope and do not change Markdown bytes.

scenarios.title: Search reveal, temporary expansion and clear
steps: Open Heading map.md, collapse Research and search Question A. Press Enter using the available keyboard to center the match. Toggle the search-revealed branch, then clear the search.
expected: Search reveals matches and the handle announces the effective expanded state. Temporary search toggles work; clearing search restores saved collapse intent and centers the visible parent when the selected match becomes hidden. Markdown bytes remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: Hidden map follows an empty source file
steps: Open Heading map.md and leave its map tab hidden. Open Heading map empty.md in the editor, then reveal the map. Navigate from the file root body to the source file top.
expected: The empty document root is fully visible, with its file icon and disabled zero handle. Navigation reaches the correct source file top; no stale headings remain and Markdown bytes are unchanged.

scenarios.title: Zoom controls, fit and narrow toolbar
steps: Open Heading map.md. Use plus/minus, Fit and the percentage reset with the full tree and again with the file root collapsed. On Android use a narrow portrait viewport; on desktop narrow the map pane.
expected: Button zoom keeps the viewport-center anchor fixed, including small trees and canvas boundaries. Fit centers the tree; reset returns to 100%. The toolbar wraps without hiding controls and Markdown bytes remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: Desktop canvas and keyboard navigation
steps: Open Heading map.md. Pan the blank canvas in both directions, use ordinary wheel and Ctrl/Cmd-wheel at each canvas boundary and with a small collapsed tree.
Use Tab and Enter to activate heading cards and handles, then navigate to Level nine in the source.
expected: Pan and zoom remain responsive; pointer-anchored wheel zoom does not jump at boundaries. Keyboard focus remains visible and usable, navigation reaches the correct source line and Markdown bytes remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: Android canvas pan and sidebar boundaries
steps: Open Heading map.md in portrait. Touch-drag the blank canvas horizontally and vertically in both directions, including near both edges; release and use a card and toolbar control.
expected: The map pans without opening either host sidebar. Release leaves controls responsive and no stuck drag. Markdown bytes remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: Android interrupted touch drag
steps: Begin a map drag in Heading map.md, exercise a real touch cancellation, and try another drag and a card. Record unverified with the missing mechanism if cancellation cannot be generated; a normal pointer release does not cover cancellation.
expected: Cancellation clears drag state; subsequent pan, card navigation and controls remain usable without changing Markdown bytes.

scenarios.title: Map state follows renamed and shifted source headings
steps: Open Heading map.md, select Research, collapse it and enter its subtree. Rename that heading in the editor, then insert a new Repeated heading before the existing sections; return to the map after each edit.

Keep Adjust structure off during the rename/insertion identity checks. Explicit same-parent section edits are covered separately by native-outline-section-reorder; do not interpret non-writing refresh as a read-only restriction on explicit structure mode. Restore deliberate editor edits and verify the baseline source before closeout.
expected: Unambiguously matched selection, subtree scope and collapse state stay with the original section after renaming and insertion. Numbers and direct-child counts refresh from the edited source; map refresh adds no source writes.

scenarios.title: Same-file desktop pane origin and stale buffers
steps: Open Heading map.md in two editor panes. Switch rapidly between them while editing a heading, then navigate from the map back to the originating pane.
expected: Delayed old-pane buffers never replace the active source snapshot. Map navigation retains the originating editor pane and reaches the intended heading.

scenarios.title: Virtual numbering, previewed writes, cleanup, captions, and references
steps: Verify virtual numbering and caption rendering without changing fixture bytes
Place the selection in either of the two explicit same-file references and verify only that source syntax is revealed
Preview Write, confirm it, then preview and confirm Cleanup
expected: Virtual display and IME composition never invoke Editor or Vault writes
Only the selected explicit reference source is revealed in Live Preview
Write and Cleanup are preview-first and preserve fenced pseudo-headings and unrelated frontmatter

scenarios.title: Protected YAML, HTML and inline comments
steps: Open Protected source, inspect outline, caption code and visible note references; preview Write and apply, then undo.
expected: Only Real heading and Child participate in heading numbering; YAML scalar and HTML content remain unchanged. The visible Figure title retains foo(), and only the two references outside the multiline comment are numbered.

scenarios.title: Continuous current-note edits
steps: Open Section skip rules.md in Live Preview and Current note. Its H2 rule has Starting number 4 and Sections to skip 1. The skipped section 访谈提纲 and its subheadings 访谈目标 and 开放问题 have no virtual numbers. Verify 试用总结 = 4 and 下一步 = 4.1 in the note, native Outline and Write preview. Cancel the preview. Remove the H2 rule with one click; its card disappears and both H2 directives are removed. Preserve all other Properties and restore the fixture afterward.
Open Current note on Controls; enter H1 first number 123 rapidly and H2 skip first 2, commit by blur, change virtual and conceal overrides, then reopen the panel.

Enter an invalid H1 value and verify inline feedback without a save; correct it. Run Simulate concurrent H1 change on next note save, then commit H1 value 3. Retry, inspect saved 7 versus draft 3, and explicitly apply the draft or discard and reload.
expected: The H2 rule card identifies its level and labels both numeric inputs. The body, native Outline and write preview skip the entire first H2 section and resume at 4 and 4.1. Removing the rule clears both H2 overrides together.

The final numbers and both overrides persist, the active input remains usable, and the save status settles to Saved without lost input. Invalid numeric text does not save, and Retry alone never overwrites a divergent same-field edit.

scenarios.title: Navigation, preview state and long notes
steps: Open Long document, edit a heading and inspect image tooltips. Navigate outline entries and expand/collapse sections using the available input method. On desktop open the same file twice and navigate from the second pane.

Open Controls in one pane. Run the fixture command Delay next preview apply for 20 seconds, then preview Write and confirm. Inspect Applying and attempt dismissal during the delay; wait for normal completion. The provider is inert until explicitly armed and is excluded from release assets.
expected: Navigation reaches the intended heading and retains the originating desktop pane. Outline buttons keep usable focus. Tooltip content updates without visible interaction stalls. Dismissal cannot imply cancellation after applying begins.

scenarios.title: Batch write conflicts and retained recovery
steps: Use disposable copies of two fixture notes. Preview a batch Write, then introduce an editor change while applying or restoring; inspect the conflict notice and retained recovery. On desktop also exercise two panes temporarily showing pre-write and replacement content.
Induce a later-file failure after one file has been written, edit the already-written file, and attempt recovery. Record unverified if the host cannot deterministically exercise the timing.
expected: Writes and restores reject divergent editor buffers at the guarded write boundary. A just-published buffer or the exact expected pre-write content remains valid during host propagation.
Rollback never overwrites a conflicting buffer. Uncertain writes retain the recovery snapshot; unchanged files and unrelated user text remain intact.

scenarios.title: Literal semantics, caption table ownership and reload boundaries
steps: Open Literal boundaries in Live Preview and Reading View. Code, inline math and block equation interiors keep their literal appearance; the first actual Figure and first prose footnote start at 1. The short GFM table has no caption pill in its data, and the standalone Table caption starts at 1. Compare the complete source before and after both views.

Copy a cross-reference from Existing reference target. The clipboard keeps Original-ID, no confirmation or source edit occurs, and the existing reference still resolves. Inspect the source to confirm there is still only one ID.

In the omitted-pipe table invoke the caption action from its header and confirm Actual table. Both data rows stay in the table, exactly one new Table caption appears above, and one Undo restores the complete original source. Repeat the genuine adjacent equation caption control without inserting a blank line.

On desktop switch source/Live Preview repeatedly, close a popout containing rendered carriers, then reopen it and invoke a caption menu. Each event contributes once; native direct target handlers remain usable. On Android repeat view switching and reopening the note; record window-only steps as not applicable.

Change a global setting and immediately disable/re-enable the plugin; verify the latest accepted value survives. If storage failure/retry timing cannot be induced, record it as unverified rather than inferred from successful reload.
expected: No semantic reference or note number is drawn inside code or equations. Equation objects still bind an external caption and table data never becomes a caption. Display-only steps preserve source bytes.
Confirmed caption edits are bounded and independently undoable. Reloaded settings retain accepted saves; closed views or windows do not contribute stale menu listeners.

scenarios.title: Roman boundary previews and successful batch recovery control
steps: In a fresh disposable Vault, run Number Suite acceptance provider: Prepare audit Roman boundaries. This explicit setup only creates synthetic source files under Audit Roman; it invokes no tested product action and produces no verdict. Existing audit folders are never overwritten. Do not prepare these inputs for unrelated scenarios.

Record the complete sources of Audit Roman valid.md, Audit Roman range.md and the two Batch safety notes. The Roman notes use the existing Chinese traditional chapters scheme, whose H7 template is {7.roman_upper}., and a per-note H7 start of 3999. Keep the existing templates cleanup scope; use Source mode when inspecting saved Markdown.

Open Audit Roman range.md in Live Preview and Reading View. The first H7 may display MMMCMXCIX.; the second must not display 4000. or a duplicate Roman label. Invoke Write numbers and Renumber through the product UI. Both previews must explain the 1–3999 range and produce no changes anywhere in the note, including its H1. Cancel and compare the full source.

In that disposable note, edit the H7 start property from 3999 to 4000 through the normal editor, then repeat Write and Renumber. Both remain non-writable. Change its scheme property to chinese-official to exercise the built-in lowercase Roman H7 format and repeat. Only these deliberate property edits may differ from the original.

Open Audit Roman valid.md and use Write numbers. Confirm that the one H7 receives MMMCMXCIX., then Remove numbers with known templates and confirm that it returns exactly to its original source. Repeat the write/cleanup control after changing only the per-note scheme to chinese-official; the label is mmmcmxcix. and cleanup returns to that edited baseline.

Preview and apply a fresh batch limited to Batch safety, then use Undo last batch through the UI. Verify both notes return exactly to their recorded sources and the normal completion notices match the operations. This is the successful host recovery control only. No existing fixture deterministically injects batch disk/rollback failures: partial, uncertain and before-commit failure outcomes remain separately covered by tests/commands/batch.test.ts and must not be recorded as host-verified.
expected: Write and Renumber refuse the complete note when any generated Roman counter exceeds 3999; the valid boundary still writes and cleans up through the default known-template path in both cases.

The real host positive control restores a normal batch. Fault-injected rollback notices and retained snapshots are source-test evidence unless a separate actual host fault is observed; no private product API is used to supply a verdict.
